verdict.rationale: Working Copy connects to remotes directly over ssh, https, git, and http, supports private GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, and Gitea instances, and uses its own SSH key identities. A community user reports pushing and pulling against their own self-hosted VPS git server. missing for 10: no explicit docs statement that traffic never passes through a vendor relay or proxy, no evidence on reaching LAN or private-network hosts without a VPN, and only one thin independent corroboration.
